target: LineageOS 22.2 (Android 15) ARM32 Android TV / Samsung Nike-L (Q60T)
disclaimer: Planungs-/Verifikationsanalyse. Kein TV-Zugriff, kein Build auf Hardware, kein Flash. Status beschreibt Portierbarkeit, nicht funktionierende Treiber.

architecture.reason: Build 061: EL3/secure monitor is AArch32 -> SCR_EL3.RW not settable -> arm64 not bootable
architecture.kernel: Build 059 Linux 6.6.162 ARM32 (CONFIG_ARM_LPAE, ARCH_MULTI_V7); NOT the 4.1.10 stock kernel

buildability.los_22_2_arm32_atv_proven_by: sabrina (Chromecast with Google TV): LOS 22.2, Android:arm (32-bit), Mali-G31
buildability.emulator_target_sdk_tv_arm: UNVERIFIED - AOSP removed aosp_tv_arm (CTS bug 258197384); confirm against LineageOS 22.2 manifest

drivers.note: upstream in Linux 6.6.162; 4.1.10-era gaps (Build 012-017) no longer apply

drivers.open_driver: Panfrost (Mesa) supports Mali-G51 Bifrost v7, GLES 3.1 / GL 3.1
drivers.gralloc: ARM Apache-licensed Bifrost Android gralloc module
drivers.blocker: real GPU ID unverified on device

drivers.note: needs 6.6 DRM/KMS driver + drm_hwcomposer (AIDL HWC); Build 058 ported sdp_drm_util/fence as start; critical path because Panfrost depends on it
Build 059: UART console, clk-sdp1804 (read-only), GPIO, eMMC node (dw_mmc-exynos, disabled), USB EHCI/OHCI (disabled), Q60T DTS 1.5G/2G; eMMC is P0 for a real boot target

drivers.dt: samsung,sdp-hdmi; cecif disabled in both reference DTBs

drivers.note: chipset not clearly mapped in static DTB
no confirmed Android hardware-DRM HAL; not guaranteed even after a successful boot

milestone_order: 1. 32-bit ARM Android 15 userspace in emulator/QEMU (no Samsung drivers)
2. Linux 6.6.162 ARM32 kernel on device (bootchain/signature = separate gate, Build 061)
3. Display KMS + Panfrost + gralloc -> first picture
open_verifications: real GPU model ID on the device
